history.notes: stats.bat keeps every day: items scanned, items with stats read, total scans, saved in scan_history.csv
49 new items the game added (Lakelis Statue, King Slime Balloon, Hero's set and more); the item list now refreshes from the site daily

Names cut off by the shop's width are matched to the right item, and misread names are never saved as new items (any already saved are cleared). Reports how many shops it reads straight off the pixels.

Much more accurate and much lighter on your PC. Prices, item names and seller names are now read straight off the game's own pixel font, and scroll tiers from their icons (Chaos included, and on sold rows). Most shops no longer need the text readers at all, which uses about 20 times less CPU.
Fixes the reader error that stopped shops from being saved while you hover an item with screenshot saving on.
Reads the upgrades-left line far more often, even over a bright chat background. Expensive equips (500K and up) send a picture of their popup so the site can show it.
Shop rooms always read as a Free Market room: a minimap title read in another font keeps its room number.
Faster equip stats: the two reading passes run side by side and a hover no longer re-reads the whole shop, so the read chime comes about twice as fast
Shorter equip stats tips in the README.
Equip stats read much more reliably: the watcher now reads only the item popup itself, so the chat box or players behind it no longer get in the way. Scrolled (orange) item names are read too.
README: how to read equip stats best (shop window high, popup off the chat box).
Fixes the game window not being found on some PCs (an 'int too long to convert' error repeating in the window).

Clicked chat links: stats now attach to posts up to 15 minutes old, wait 10 minutes for a post read late, and the log says why when they can't (no price in the post, or stats the item can't have). Scan stats now count equip stats read.
A config.json with a typo no longer stops the watcher: it's set aside as config-broken.json and fresh settings are used. Works with VPN and proxy apps that switch on a SOCKS system proxy.

Works with VPN and proxy apps that switch on a SOCKS system proxy: start.bat and install.bat go around it, and start.bat installs any missing Python package itself. Hover stats are checked against what the item can carry before they're kept.

Hover stats are checked before they're kept: attack on earrings, boots or hats means the popup belonged to another item and is skipped, and a requirement read as a bonus is dropped. start.bat now installs any missing Python package itself, and works with VPN or proxy apps that broke the install (SOCKS). Updates itself.

New items: when a shop has an item the watcher has never seen, hovering it once reads its full name off the tooltip, and from then on that item is read, priced and uploaded with its icon. Cut-off names also finish themselves from items other scanners found. Close your watcher and open start.bat to update.

FM Entrance reading: dark chalkboards (black, brown, purple) are read now, rolls like +2 or 65 watk are kept, (2) is read as how many they have, prices without a k are fixed, and a post read with one digit wrong (90K vs 30K) keeps the right one. Close your watcher and open start.bat to update.
Scan stats: the watcher prints your last hour and today (new listings, shops, sales caught, listings per active hour) at the top of every hour, and stats.bat shows them any time.
Hover wanted list now reads from the public price summary.
Hover wanted: the watcher now tells you (with a two-note chime) when a shop has an equip the board needs stats for. Just rest your mouse on that row.
Scrolled items whose tooltip title reads badly keep their stats: the row under the pointer is used. Fixes 10 attack Work Gloves showing no stats.
A short chime when a hovered item's stats are read, a low tone when a hover couldn't be read. Tooltips that open above the pointer are read too.
Reads the chalkboard posts over players' heads when you stand in the Free Market Entrance. Counted as asking prices, once a day per seller.
Prices from watchers without a GitHub key now go to Club FM's own private inbox instead of a shared sheet.
Scans now go to Club FM's private data repository, so listings stay private to members. Nothing to change on your end.

Your name: a name in config.json is never second-guessed, and a name read off the screen needs five matching reads that outvote every other guess (3-letter misreads like Toe no longer stick). Linked watchers show under the Discord account's in-game name.
Faster reading: the minimap is read once per look instead of once per shop frame, and each text reader keeps to one CPU thread so the readers stop fighting each other.

Channel changes are caught the moment you click a channel in the Change Channel window, not only when the loading screen is spotted. Bigger read queue and more readers on bigger CPUs so fast scrolling drops fewer shops.
Reminds you every 10 minutes to open the Change Channel window when no channel is known yet.
